sources.text: Smoked, naturally blued in Picos de Europa caves

facts.v: Del Puerto, from high mountain pastures June to September, with at least two milks, sheep and/or goat above 10% each; Del Valle, from the lower valleys, year-round
Smoked over a wood fire in shepherds' huts for 10 to 20 days, then ripened 2 to 5 months in natural caves in Onís
